surface_value: Navjot's work attempts to question and expand the expected interaction between artist and viewer, creating a cooperative, dialectic conversation around the work of art. In a bold challenge of the accepted delineation between “art” and “craft,” Navjot has collaborated with traditional craftspeople of India, particularly in the creation of her sculptures
